nodes.label: Sanitized Logs Requirement
nodes.rationale: Bug reports must strip tokens, cookies, API keys, project paths and raw session content so secrets never leave the machine

nodes.label: Feature Request Constraints
nodes.rationale: Proposed features must stay local-only by default (no implicit network calls or analytics) and add no third-party dependency

nodes.label: Migration Replay Gate
nodes.rationale: Replays pre-versioned fixtures through the real migration path to make migration correctness a deterministic, data-loss-sensitive gate rather than a timing assumption

nodes.label: Keychain Credential Storage Rule
nodes.rationale: API keys and cookies belong in the macOS Keychain; secrets are never logged, printed or stored in SQLite/plists

nodes.label: Zero Third-Party Dependency Constraint
nodes.rationale: Everything ships with system frameworks (AppKit, SwiftUI, sqlite3, Security); libraries are reconsidered because almost everything is a small amount of system-API code

nodes.label: Money Semantics (Never Mix Sums)
nodes.rationale: The UI must not add money values unconditionally; any sum must declare its basis, and plan 'value used' must never be called 'spend'

nodes.label: Time Semantics
nodes.rationale: Times are Unix seconds; 0 means unknown and the UI shows '—', never 1970; never query columns that do not exist

nodes.label: Token Semantics
nodes.rationale: cacheWriteTokens are recorded separately and never merged into input; billableInputTokens derive from provider billing rules, never a stored guess

nodes.label: Protected Backup Before Destructive Ops
nodes.rationale: Migrations must never delete or reset the user's database; a protected backup is created before clear/repair and the original database is never further modified on failure

nodes.label: PRAGMA user_version Migrations
nodes.rationale: Versioned migrations run inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions so failure rolls back and keeps user_version=0 for retry; idempotent ensureColumn ALTERs run outside transactions

nodes.label: Byte-Offset Cursor Incremental Parsing
nodes.rationale: File changes are detected via (size, nanosecond mtime, inode); the cursor parses only appended lines and a partial trailing line is never consumed, so steady-state idle scans cost ~20ms

nodes.label: Dedupe Chain
nodes.rationale: Upstream event ID to derived ID (file + inode + mtime + byte offset) to a global unique index on (tool, event_id) with INSERT OR IGNORE ensures re-scanning or replaying never double-counts

nodes.label: Cumulative Delta Baseline Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Cumulative rows (OpenCode, Hermes) are converted to deltas against persisted baselines; shrinking fields clamp to 0 and shared keys across local/remote prevent double-counting on source switch

nodes.label: Master Token Total Formula
nodes.rationale: Total tokens = input + output + cacheRead; the only exception is Codex whose input already includes cache; cacheWrite is recorded but never counted in totals

nodes.label: DSH Dual Parse Modes (Log/Cache)
nodes.rationale: Log mode and cache mode are mutually exclusive and sticky (dsh_parse_mode) so the two accounting paths can never double-count when zstd is installed or removed

nodes.label: Local-Only Privacy Default
nodes.rationale: User data stays on the Mac unless an explicit remote feed or quota service is enabled; no analytics, telemetry or implicit network calls

nodes.label: Remote Feed Validation Rules
nodes.rationale: Only explicitly configured addresses are contacted, addresses are validated client-side, credential requests never follow redirects, and no personal IPs or default remote hosts ship in the app

nodes.label: Signed Update Verification
nodes.rationale: UpdateChecker validates the Ed25519 metadata signature, version and SHA-256 of the download; files download only after user confirmation and are re-verified before use
